title: Verdant launch model manifest
description: Everything a launch model fixes at creation, what a creator chooses inside it, what it does not promise, and where in this repository each claim is checked. Generated from packages/config/src/launch-models.ts and models.ts — the same data the interface renders — so this record cannot describe a market the product would not create.

quotedIn.description: What the market is priced against, for a human.

rewardCurrency.description: What a creator's fee share actually arrives in. Uniswap charges the fee on the currency entering the pool, so this is usually two currencies rather than one.

mechanism.description: Plain-language behaviour. No metaphor without a definition.

creatorChooses.description: Parameters rendered as controls in the create flow. Listing one a creator cannot set would be a false disclosure, not a cosmetic error.

fixedAtCreation.description: Behaviour nobody can change afterwards, including Verdant.

remaining.description: Required for any model short of `ready`: what is actually left to do.

decisions.description: Architecture decision records explaining why this model works the way it does.

deployment.description: Null for any model that is not deployed. A model cannot cite a deployment it does not have.
